title: Benchmark run provenance block (SPEC-003-020)
description: The `provenance` object embedded in a new run's run_info.json (and mirrored into scores*.json by the scoring paths). Every field is required and must be present even when its value cannot be determined — an undeterminable field is the literal string 'unknown' (live runs) or 'unavailable' (the historical run-index), never omitted and never inferred from a directory name.
